title: IIT exclusion postulate: integrating substrates have the WHOLE as the main complex (holism); rule 90 has whole-Phi=0 yet a 2-cell SUB-PART complex (resolves the flow-arc rule-90 anomaly)
question: For which substrates is the maximally-irreducible complex the WHOLE n-cell system (holism), and for which does IIT exclusion pick a proper sub-part (or no complex)?

rule_90.note: whole reducible (Phi=0) yet a 2-cell subset {0,1} is irreducible (Phi=2) — exclusion picks a PART

finding: IIT's exclusion postulate localizes the maximally-irreducible complex. (1) HOLISM: integrating substrates (rules 150/105/60/110/30) have the WHOLE 4-cell system as the main complex (mask=15, size=4, complex_Phi=whole_Phi) — the whole is more irreducible than any proper part. (2) Reducible substrates (identity 204, constants 0/255, complement 51) have NO complex (Phi=0). (3) THE DECISIVE CASE — rule 90: whole-system Phi=0 yet a 2-cell SUB-PART (cells {0,1}, Phi=2) is irreducible; exclusion picks a PART, not the whole, as the conscious unit. This mechanically RESOLVES the flow-arc rule-90 anomaly: rule 90 over-predicted under LZ (H_288), multivariate TE (H_293), and synergy (H_294) because those measures saw the local integration of its sub-complex, while big-Phi(whole)=0 because the whole system-cut is reducible. The flow measures were right that integration exists somewhere, but at the WHOLE level it is zero — exclusion explains the gap. Phi is not merely a system-cut property but a property of the maximally-irreducible SUBSET.

L2: n=4 small (15-subset search); large-n complex localization is super-exponential (bounded/approx needed).
L3: rule 90 sub-complex = 2-cell {0,1} is ring/state-dependent; the qualitative fact (whole 0 / part >0) is the point, not the specific mask.
L4: whole_Phi single-state (state 5) differs from the state-averaged Phi_mean of the flow arc (e.g. rule60 17.5 vs 13.6) — same engine, different aggregation.
L5: structure-cut big-Phi; exclusion conclusion is a relative (whole vs part) comparison, robust to scale offset.
L6: ECA = proxy, NOT a phenomenal claim ('rule 90's part is conscious'); structural measurement of the exclusion postulate.
L7: verdict is a toy-substrate measurement fact.
